prepare-once.description: Builds the libraries once per npm run build, not once per app and site. Points each project's pre* hooks at `angular-capacitor-workspace prepare`, which the project runner skips once it has run codegen and the library build itself.

theme-story-providers.description: Gives the theme toggle's Storybook story the `provideTheme()` an app gives the toggle. Since 22.6 `ThemeService` throws "ThemeService has no palettes" without it, so the story failed to render.
